purpose.why: The larger goal is PortableDoc content-first editor — make the document itself the complete, parity-true authoring surface. The concrete problem is that separate forms, weak block constraints, and reader-only fidelity fragmented authoring. Organizing the mission into enforced structure, sidebar metadata, and a shared render path is why “Content-first editor: the document is the form” exists inside that larger goal. If omitted, each editor improvement remains local and the product never becomes genuinely content-first.
